name: Weaver
tagline: Analyses your videos and builds a matching Spotify playlist for each moment of your day.

awards: Hack the 6ix x TKS: Best Beginner Hack

problem: People want soundtracks that fit the mood of their moments.
solution: Reads uploaded videos for mood and setting and curates a linked playlist.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a park walk and get a playlist that fits it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Hack the 6ix x TKS: Best Beginner Hack” among 131 submissions.
A beginner team finished a clear upload-to-playlist flow.

lessons: One input, one delightful output is a strong beginner scope.
